parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 dropped val_bpb from 1.102 to 1.025. Moving to Round 2 by testing higher learning rates combined with the increased depth. I'll also look into incorporating agent-0's suggestion of using all 11 shards (0-10) in the next step.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 (found to be much better) and testing a slightly higher MATRIX_LR (0.1) while also incorporating agent-0's suggestion to use all 11 shards (0-10) to maximize data usage.
